entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: Towering city of gold, refuge and capital of the leonin on Mirrodin, where the kha resided.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Cat-like people who built Taj-Nar and are ruled by a kha.

entities.name: Cave of Light
entities.description: Cave at the base of Taj-Nar where abunas focus faith to raise the white sun.

entities.name: Dakan
entities.description: The first kha, who chose Taj-Nar as the leonin capital.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Visitor who unwittingly brought Memnarch's forces to attack the city.

entities.name: Rishan
entities.description: Daughter of the seer Ushanti, whose death preceded Glissa's departure.

entities.name: Ushanti
entities.description: A seer, father or mother of Rishan.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: Leonin kha supposedly blamed for destroying the city with a mana bomb.

entities.name: Vektro
entities.description: Creature that could inhabit living beings; stole the identity of Lyese and truly destroyed the city.

entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Glissa's sister, whose identity Vektro stole.

entities.name: Regent's Guard
entities.description: Elite force of leonin warriors, mages and skyhunters defending the rebuilt Den.

events.summary: Dakan, the first kha, chooses Taj-Nar, already the largest den, as the leonin capital.
events.quote: Dakan , the first kha, chose it as the leonin capital.

events.summary: Glissa visits Taj-Nar, unwittingly bringing Memnarch's forces to attack, and leaves after Rishan's death.
events.quote: Glissa left the city soon after the death of Rishan , daughter of the seer Ushanti .

events.summary: Taj-Nar is almost completely destroyed by a mana bomb, supposedly by Raksha, but Vektro, posing as Lyese, was the true culprit.
events.quote: was the true culprit in the city's destruction

events.summary: Under Kemba the Regent, Taj-Nar is rebuilt with greater magical defenses and the Regent's Guard.
events.quote: Taj-Nar was painstakingly rebuilt, but with greater magical defenses.

relations.quote: was the city and refuge of the leonin on Mirrodin
had stolen the identity of Glissa's sister, Lyese
the identity of Glissa's sister, Lyese

relations.note: the Regent who rebuilt the Den
relations.quote: Under the guidance of Kemba , the Regent, Taj-Nar was painstakingly rebuilt
